label: original-phase "3" input, or outputting "1"/"m"
explanation: Diffuse unit that needs two unrelated clauses. (1) Original phase, input digit 3: fires on 55% of these steps (6x lift), and harder at later positions. (2) Delimiter/copy steps whose output token is 1 or m (out_tok 1: 8.7x lift, m: 5.6x). Weaker lifts for outputs 0, n, z, j and for sequences with many digits. It also fires on about 20% of <DEL> steps, more often in long sequences (L>=8) and when the first token is 1 or m; on its own <DEL> accounts for 37% of activation mass. The largest activations come on a 3 near the end of the original sequence followed by <DEL>. The disjunction reaches only about F1 0.42 / mass recall 0.46 on dev, and many weak activations in the original and copy phases are left unexplained. It rarely fires on ordinary letters in the original phase.
